background: La Banque Postale is the banking arm of the French post office, owned by La Poste and ultimately by the French state, funded by a large base of retail deposits collected through post offices and lending on mortgages and to the public sector, with CNP Assurances as its insurer.
synthesis: Rated A on average across all three, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is a clear strength, with CET1 of 19.0% and leverage of 7.4% both in the top quarter of EU and Nordic banks, and liquidity is sound, LCR of 183% in the top quarter and NSFR of 124% above the peer median. CET1 has risen 0.8 points and leverage 0.3 points since 30 Jun 2025, with the liquidity ratios broadly flat. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
